text: Chapter 10: The Lost God's Ship@The Whereabouts of the Missing Monks
■Next Mission\nMove from Celarra Plateau to Arche Valley to start.
Head to where the ark is by going down the rocky and bumpy\nArche Valley while exterminating the evil spirits and\nmonsters!
There is a barrier to block evil spirits and monsters around\nthe ark. Beat the Trainee Monk Spirits who have risked their\nlives to protect it and ask them to remove the barrier!
Fight and defeat Arachnidemon, an evil spirit that has\nturned into a monster and is disrupting the work of lifting\nthe ark!
